visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of each listed unmodified native PNG at original resolution, alongside its published/source counterpart. Capture SHA-256 values verified against the raw report. No synthetic full-page composite or screenshot padding was used.

pairs.label: 320-join-writing
pairs.finding: Process photograph, its bottom padding and the warm paper writing section meet at the same position. The writing heading retains the same three-line wrapping and teal italic emphasis. The viewport edge cuts through the introduction at the same point; no missing paint or join displacement is visible.

pairs.label: 390-join-writing
pairs.finding: The process photograph, warm paper transition, two-line writing heading and introduction match. The sticky header remains visible over the process image in both native captures.

pairs.label: 820-join-writing
pairs.finding: The process image crop, writing section start and two-line heading match at the tablet width. The header overlays the image in the same position, with the same login and menu controls.

pairs.label: 1440-join-writing
pairs.finding: The process actions, right-hand photograph and writing heading join at the same absolute position. The desktop navigation and heading scale, line breaks and surrounding space match.

pairs.label: 320-join-gifting
pairs.finding: The bottom of the mobile practice composition, outlined practice action, sage-to-warm-paper transition and rounded Gifting photograph match. The native viewport contains no missing paint or unintended section overlap.

pairs.label: 390-join-gifting
pairs.finding: The practice action and its spacing into the Gifting photograph match. The photographic crop, rounded corners and section background transition are the same.

pairs.label: 820-join-gifting
pairs.finding: The lower device edges, centred practice action, spacing and two-column Gifting panel match. The forest text panel and photographic crop share the same join and dimensions.

pairs.label: 1440-join-gifting
pairs.finding: The practice action, large intervening space and desktop Gifting panel match, including the forest panel, rounded outer corners and photograph. The narrow retained underlay equivalence produces the same visible paint.

pairs.label: 320-ending
pairs.finding: The footer logo, currency control, tagline, two-column book/explore groups, help group and legal row match. Default-size labels fit within the viewport. Get in touch has no arrow. This bottom viewport does not show the full newsletter introduction.

pairs.label: 390-ending
pairs.finding: The footer and lower newsletter form area match, including the mobile groups, currency placement, line wrapping and legal row. Default-size labels fit. The photographic background fades into the same forest field.

pairs.label: 820-ending
pairs.finding: The complete visible newsletter and footer field matches: single-line newsletter heading, form, three-column main footer, help row and legal row. The photograph and fade remain continuous.

pairs.label: 1440-ending
pairs.finding: The desktop photographic newsletter and footer field matches. Newsletter text/form alignment, four-column footer, gold logo and headings, currency control, legal rule and final Get in touch label all retain the approved arrangement.

pairs.label: 1440-assembled-process-342
pairs.finding: With normal motion, stage four is selected and the complete process grid is held below the sticky header. Text, circular markers, inset dividers, actions and album photograph match.

pairs.label: 1440-assembled-process-422
pairs.finding: The deliberate stage-four hold is visibly preserved while the writing section begins to approach the viewport bottom. The process grid remains at the same held coordinate in both captures.

pairs.label: 1440-assembled-process-656
pairs.finding: After release, the process grid moves above the viewport and the writing heading enters below at the same point. Stage four remains selected, and the photograph, actions and section join match.

pairs.label: 320-join-ending
pairs.finding: The mobile invitation and photographic newsletter opening match. The invitation wraps to two lines, its action sits below, and the newsletter starts at the same height with the same heading and supporting copy.

pairs.label: 1440-join-ending
pairs.finding: The desktop invitation, right-aligned action and photographic newsletter opening meet at the same position. The newsletter heading and email form enter the viewport with matching spacing and proportions.

pairs.label: 768-join-questions
pairs.finding: This is the largest changed-pixel pair in the run. The Resources footer label, section transition, FAQ heading and Ask us a question action retain matching geometry and visible layout. No missing paint or section-join mismatch is visible at native resolution.

visualReview.finding: No missing paint, displaced section join, unexpected overlap or visible composition mismatch was found within this representative sample. Native captures include the expected sticky header and natural viewport-edge cuts.
limits: This is a representative manual review of 18 pairs, not an individual manual inspection of every one of the 146 automated screenshot pairs.
The writing device composition and dialog have a separate dedicated verification owner; these assembly screenshots principally cover the joins and complete-page interactions.
Default-size fit in this sample does not resolve the separately recorded inherited text-enlargement findings.

Chromium 155.0.8059.39 on an Ubuntu GitHub-hosted runner, device scale factor 1. Touch interaction is Chromium emulation. No physical device, native browser zoom, other browser engine or accessibility certification is claimed.
Package 4, founder visual acceptance and explicit permission to publish the React homepage remain separate gates.

summaryScope: Independent verification of the third Assembly run and its representative native screenshot sample. This does not close other Group 8 evidence, documentation, retained workflow or publication gates.
